notes.title: 📢 "KATUBA's Poacher" is participating in Tokyo Game Show! 🤩
notes.content:
Hello! Nice to meet you.
This is Joe Yu, the developer of [b]“KATUBA’s Poacher”[/b]! 😊

[b]“KATUBA’s Poacher”[/b] will be participating in the Korean Pavilion at Tokyo Game Show 2024 [u]from September 26th to 29th[/u]! 🤩

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306559/562e69642a9ed16b3213ed7150b4426596aa308f.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Makuhari Messe Hall 3 N09 (Sep 26–29) KATUBA's poacher
[/list]

Along with this, a Japanese build and a small update for gamepad controls have been added to the Steam version, and after TGS, we plan to work on UI adjustments.

I will also have small gifts and events at the exhibition, so I would appreciate it if those attending Tokyo Game Show could stop by my booth!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306559/429ca99c4addcbb9fec1dfe2fd162c83a539681f.png[/img]

For updates on the event, please follow us on [url=https://x.com/KatubasPoacher/]X (Twitter)[/url]!
[list]
[*] [url=https://x.com/KatubasPoacher/]https://x.com/KatubasPoacher[/url]
[/list]

We’ll be sharing updates via Steam as well, so please stay tuned! 🥹
